definitions.explanation: A winter that is warmer than average. Used as a meteorological and everyday term to describe winters with higher-than-normal temperatures.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{暖冬|だんとう}だ。
examples.english: This year is a mild winter.

examples.japanese: {暖冬|だんとう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{雪|ゆき}→雪：00584_yuki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{少|すく}ない→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧。
examples.english: There is little snow due to the mild winter.

examples.japanese: {暖冬|だんとう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦スキー→スキー：03849_sukii⟧{場|じょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{経営|けいえい}→経営：02740_keiei⟧や⟦{冬物|ふゆもの}→冬物：27498_fuyumono⟧⟦{衣料|いりょう}→衣料：02612_iryou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{売|う}り{上|あ}げ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: If mild winters continue, they have a major impact on ski resort management and winter clothing sales.

notes:
A compound of {暖|だん} (warm) and {冬|とう} (winter). Frequently heard in weather forecasts and news, especially in discussions about climate change and its effects on agriculture and the economy.

USAGE:
- Often used with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ as a modifier: {暖冬|だんとう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{年|とし}→年：00486_toshi⟧ (a mild winter year)
- Commonly appears in weather forecasts and seasonal reports
- The Japan Meteorological Agency officially declares a {暖冬|だんとう} when average winter temperatures exceed the norm

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {暖冬|だんとう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧: effects of mild winter
- {暖冬|だんとう}⟦{傾向|けいこう}→傾向：02695_keikou⟧: tendency toward mild winters
- ⟦{記録的|きろくてき}→記録的：28788_kirokuteki⟧な{暖冬|だんとう}: record-breaking mild winter
- {暖冬|だんとう}⟦{予報|よほう}→予報：03668_yohou⟧: mild winter forecast

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{厳冬|げんとう}→厳冬：08556_gentou⟧: severe winter, harsh winter — the opposite; an unusually cold winter
- {冷夏|れいか}: cool summer — the summer equivalent of an abnormally cool season
- ⟦{猛暑|もうしょ}→猛暑：08311_mousho⟧: extreme heat — an abnormally hot summer
